card.name: Hours in every-N-hours dosing
card.fires_on: The time unit (hours, h, intervals) right after a number in a repeating-dose phrase such as "every 6 hours" or "q6 to 8h". It responds in dosing directions that set a regular schedule.

modes.label: Every N hours
modes.description: The word hours after "every" and a number in a dosing schedule.
modes.example: Administer levoleucovorin for injection 7.5 mg (approximately 5 mg/m 2 ) intravenously every 6<< hours>> until methotrexate level is less

modes.label: Abbreviated or interval forms
modes.description: The abbreviation h after q and a number, or the word intervals after a number of minutes.
